I am 70 years old this year, farming 12 mu in Quzhou County. Never went to school, but I've held a hoe for 50 years. My father taught me, and now I watch my neighbors — especially Old Wang with the 15 mu next door. If his wheat grows well, I do what he does.

**Winter wheat:** I plant improved wheat seed at 25 jin per mu. Before planting, I spread one 50kg bag of compound fertilizer on every mu. When March comes and the wheat turns green, I top-dress with 25kg of urea per mu — that's half a bag. I learned that if I put less, the ears get thin. I irrigate three times: once after planting to settle the soil, once in late March when it greens up, and once in May when the heads are filling. If the weather is dry, I might add another, but three usually does it. I spray twice — once in April for aphids, and once in May if I see yellow rust on the leaves. After the maize is cut, I rotary till the stalks into the ground to get the land ready. Last year I got about 500 kg per mu. This year I hope for 520 kg if no disaster hits.

**Summer maize:** As soon as the wheat comes off in June, I plant hybrid maize. I buy the seed in the yellow bag — about 3 jin per mu. I put one 50kg bag of compound fertilizer in the ground at planting time for each mu. In July, when the maize is knee-high, I spread 25kg of urea per mu on top. I don't plough the wheat stubble; the planter cuts right through it. I just call it saving time and diesel. I irrigate twice: once right after planting so the seeds sprout fast, and once in August if the heat bakes the soil. I spray pesticide twice — once when the seedlings are small for cutworms, and once when the tassels come out for borers. I expect 600 kg per mu. Last year was 580, so this year should be the same.

Everything costs money. Compound fertilizer is 160 yuan per bag, urea is 110 yuan. For 12 mu I need many bags. But my grandson is in school and needs money. A bad harvest means borrowing from relatives. I'd rather spend an extra 500 yuan on fertilizer than risk losing 2,000 yuan in grain. So I do what I did last year, because last year worked.
